n: Bánh Bông Lan Trứng Muối Gốc Cột Điện
address: Nguyễn Thái Học, Phường 7, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
w: Vũng Tàu's originator of bánh bông lan trứng muối (salted-egg sponge cake), open since 1986 — a feather-light sponge loaded with salted egg yolk, cheese and pork floss. Named for the electric pole (cột điện) it started beside; the cake that made this a citywide take-home specialty.
dish: bánh bông lan trứng muối (salted-egg sponge cake)

address: 44 Trương Công Định, Phường 3, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
w: The best-known address for lẩu cá đuối (stingray hotpot) — Vũng Tàu's signature dish: sweet, chewy stingray in a sour-spicy tamarind-and-pickled-bamboo broth. A long-running budget seafood institution on Trương Công Định.

address: 3 Trần Phú, Front Beach (Bãi Trước), Phường 5, Vũng Tàu, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
w: Vũng Tàu's legendary open-air seafood house, sprawling over a rocky waterfront where waves break metres from the table — fresh crab, prawns and grilled fish with a sunset sea view. The classic Front Beach seafood stop for weekending Saigonese.
dish: hải sản (fresh seafood, grilled fish & crab)

address: 11 Cách Mạng Tháng Tám, Long Hương, Bà Rịa, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
w: The famous 'cổng chào' (welcome-gate) bánh canh at the entrance to Bà Rịa — thick chewy rice-tapioca noodles in a marrow-rich pork broth, topped with the signature xương que nạc (meaty pork rib). A mandatory pit-stop on the drive to Vũng Tàu.
dish: bánh canh xương que nạc (pork-rib tapioca noodle soup)

address: Quốc lộ 55, An Nhứt, Long Điền, Bà Rịa–Vũng Tàu, Vietnam
w: A 60-year-old roadside institution in An Nhứt village (Long Điền) making bánh hỏi — gossamer, net-woven rice-vermicelli sheets from local Long Điền rice, served with grilled meat, chives oil and herbs. The area's defining specialty on the QL55 corridor.

address: Quốc lộ 51, Long Thành, Đồng Nai, Vietnam
w: The roadside dairy that everyone stops for en route to Vũng Tàu — Long Thành's fresh pasteurised cow's milk and its take-home bánh sữa (milk cakes) and kẹo sữa (milk candy), a recognised Đồng Nai regional specialty since the 1980s.
dish: sữa bò tươi & bánh sữa Long Thành (fresh milk & milk cakes)
